facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse reports that from 13 April 2026 MTN Sudan suspended internet daily from 13:45 to 17:15, except banking, under Cabinet directives during the Sudanese Certificate Examinations, with Cloudflare data showing the drop on 13, 14 and 15 April.

Internet Society Pulse reports that Starlink traffic continued during the April 2026 exam shutdowns and that, per its Sudan Country Report, Starlink is the second-largest ISP in Sudan by market share; no licence is stated.

SDN.note: The document does not say Starlink is licensed or how many networks are on sale.
